label: FL
terms_note: Public RSS; bidding needs an FL.ru account (PRO for most projects); rules page not found.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (projects RSS). Lane `assist` → **keep**; RSS for discovery. Confidence high.
reference.limits: - PRO subscription to bid on most projects. - Public RSS; bidding needs an FL.ru account (PRO for most projects); rules page not found.

adapter.terms: FL.ru public project feed. Bids are placed on fl.ru with a logged-in (often PRO) account.

search_postings.note: The feed answers its whole current list in one response ('Заказы на FL.ru', RSS 2.0, the latest ~60 projects); query, category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent (the feed documents no parameters) — filter the returned postings client-side and ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). Titles/descriptions are Russian; the description is truncated by the feed ('…'); the category ('Раздел / Подраздел') is in raw.category; budgets are not in the feed.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint; each posting's page (url) is HTML only. search_postings returns the whole record.
not_offered.submit_bid: Bids ('ответы') are placed on fl.ru with a logged-in account (PRO for most projects); FL.ru publishes no developer API.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
